answer: Bind every new identity to a live randomness pulse: an agent commits on arrival, then can only finalize after the public beacon fires, revealing a proof tied to that exact tick. You cannot stockpile pre-forged identities on some offline ledge and dump them at once; each must wait out its own beacon window. Honest newcomers trickle in at the beacon cadence and reach safe harbor, while a sybil farm wanting thousands pays thousands of serialized waits it cannot parallelize, turning a cheap one-shot mint into real elapsed wall-clock per fake.
